title: 茶餐廳點餐 Ordering at Cha Chaan Teng
titleEn: Ordering Food & Drinks at a Traditional Hong Kong Cafe
description: Master how to order regular breakfast sets, customize egg styles, and order hot milk tea with less sugar.

keywords.example_meaning: Excuse me, I would like a regular set meal.
A cup of hot milk tea with less sugar, please.
Iced lemon tea with less sugar and no ice.
For the fried egg, I want sunny-side up.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 唔該！我想叫個常餐，熱奶茶少甜。
dialogue.jyutping: m4 goi1! ngo5 soeng2 giu3 go3 soeng4 caan1, jit6 naai5 caa4 siu2 tim4.
dialogue.translation: Excuse me! I would like a regular set meal, hot milk tea with less sugar.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 好呀，常餐要叉燒湯意粉定牛油多士？
dialogue.jyutping: hou2 aa3, soeng4 caan1 jiu3 caa1 siu1 tong1 ji3 fan2 ding6 ngau4 jau4 do1 si2?
dialogue.translation: Sure, for the set meal do you want char siu soup spaghetti or butter toast?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 叉燒湯意，煎蛋要太陽蛋，唔該曬。
dialogue.jyutping: caa1 siu1 tong1 ji3, zin1 daan2 jiu3 taai3 joeng4 daan2, m4 goi1 saai3.
dialogue.translation: Char siu soup spaghetti, fried egg sunny-side up please, thanks a lot.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 冇問題，寫好咗，陣間幫你送過嚟！
dialogue.jyutping: mou5 man6 tai4, se2 hou2 zo2, zan6 gaan1 bong1 nei5 sung3 gwo3 lai4!
dialogue.translation: No problem, written down, will serve it to you shortly!

title: 搭的士過海 Taking a Taxi Across Harbour
titleEn: Giving Directions to a Hong Kong Red Taxi Driver
description: Learn how to give exact destinations, choose harbour tunnels, and request drop-off spots.

keywords.meaning_zh: 司機師傅 / 的士師傅
keywords.example_meaning: Taxi driver, to Central Ferry Pier.

keywords.meaning_zh: 西隧 / 西區海底隧道
keywords.example_meaning: Taking the Western Tunnel has less traffic.
Traffic is very congested during rush hour.
Drop off at the traffic light ahead, please!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 司機師傅，去中環天星碼頭，唔該。
dialogue.jyutping: si1 gei1 si1 fu2, heoi3 zung1 waan4 tin1 sing1 maa5 tau4, m4 goi1.
dialogue.translation: Taxi driver, to Central Star Ferry Pier please.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 好，行紅隧定行西隧？而家西隧冇咁塞車。
dialogue.jyutping: hou2, haang4 hung4 seoi6 ding6 haang4 sai1 seoi6? ji4 gaa1 sai1 seoi6 mou5 gam3 sak1 ce1.
dialogue.translation: Okay, take Cross-Harbour Tunnel or Western Tunnel? Western Tunnel is less congested right now.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 行西隧啦，我趕時間，唔該。
dialogue.jyutping: haang4 sai1 seoi6 laa1, ngo5 gon2 si4 gaan3, m4 goi1.
dialogue.translation: Let's take Western Tunnel, I'm in a rush, thanks.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 收到！前面路口落車得唔得？
dialogue.jyutping: sau1 dou2! cin4 min6 lou6 hau2 lok6 ce1 dak1 m4 dak1?
dialogue.translation: Got it! Is it okay to drop you off at the intersection ahead?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 得㗎，呢度停就得，唔該曬！
dialogue.jyutping: dak1 gaa3, ni1 dou6 ting4 zau6 dak1, m4 goi1 saai3!
dialogue.translation: Sure, stopping here is perfect, thanks a lot!

title: 旺角買嘢講價 Shopping & Bargaining in Mong Kok
titleEn: Asking for Discounts & Bargaining at Local Markets
description: Practice natural street Cantonese bargaining expressions, asking prices, and closing friendly deals.

keywords.example_meaning: How much is this shirt?
Boss, give me a discount please!
Alright, 200 dollars, deal!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 老闆，呢件外套幾多錢啊？
dialogue.jyutping: lou5 baan2, ni1 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 gei2 do1 cin2 aa3?
dialogue.translation: Boss, how much is this jacket?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 呢件好正㗎，原價三百八，算你三百啦！
dialogue.jyutping: ni1 gin6 hou2 zeng3 gaa3, jyun4 gaa3 saam1 baak3 baat3, syun3 nei5 saam1 baak3 laa1!
dialogue.translation: This one is great quality, original price 380, I'll give it to you for 300!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 哇，平啲得唔得？二百五蚊得唔得呀？
dialogue.jyutping: waa1, peng4 di1 dak1 m4 dak1? ji6 baak3 ng5 man1 dak1 m4 dak1 aa3?
dialogue.translation: Wow, can it be cheaper? Can you do 250 dollars?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 唉，當交個朋友啦，二百六啦，成交！
dialogue.jyutping: aai1, dong3 gaau1 go3 pang4 jau5 laa1, ji6 baak3 luk6 laa1, sing4 gaau1!
dialogue.translation: Alright, let's be friends, 260 dollars, deal!

title: 診所睇醫生 Visiting the Clinic
description: Learn how to describe fever, sore throat, cough, and understand doctor medication instructions.

keywords.example_meaning: I started having a fever last night.
My throat hurts a lot when eating.
Remember to watch your diet while taking medicine.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 你好，邊度唔舒服啊？
dialogue.jyutping: nei5 hou2, bin1 dou6 m4 suk6 fuk6 aa3?
dialogue.translation: Hello, where are you feeling unwell?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 我尋日起開始發燒、喉嚨痛同埋有啲咳。
dialogue.jyutping: ngo5 cam4 jat6 hei2 hoi1 ci2 faat3 siu1, hau4 lung4 tung3 tung4 maai4 jau5 di1 kat1.
dialogue.translation: I started having a fever, sore throat and coughing since yesterday.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 擘大口我睇下喉嚨，發炎幾犀利，我開三日消炎藥同退燒藥畀你。
dialogue.jyutping: maak3 daai6 hau2 ngo5 tai2 haa5 hau4 lung4, faat3 jim4 gei2 sai1 lei6, ngo5 hoi1 saam1 jat6 siu1 jim4 joek6 tung4 teoi3 siu1 joek6 bei2 nei5.
dialogue.translation: Open your mouth let me check your throat, it's quite inflamed, I'll prescribe 3 days of medication for you.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 唔該醫生，使唔使戒口？
dialogue.jyutping: m4 goi1 ji1 sang1, sai2 m4 sai2 gaai3 hau2?
dialogue.translation: Thank you doctor, do I need to avoid certain foods?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 飲多啲溫水，唔好食熱氣煎炸嘢。
dialogue.jyutping: jam2 do1 di1 wan1 seoi2, m4 hou2 sik6 jit6 hei3 zin1 zaa3 je5.
dialogue.translation: Drink plenty of warm water, avoid spicy and fried foods.

title: 飲茶搭檯叫點心 Dim Sum Table Sharing & Tea Ordering
titleEn: Traditional Hong Kong Yum Cha Etiquette & Tea Service
description: Order famous Chinese teas (Pu-erh, Jasmine, Tieguanyin), share tables politely, and request tea refills.

keywords.example_meaning: Two people, is sharing a table okay?
We would like a pot of Jasmine tea.
How much is the tea charge per person?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 侍應，兩位，請問有冇位啊？
dialogue.jyutping: si6 jing3, loeng5 wai2, cing2 man6 jau5 mou5 wai2 aa3?
dialogue.translation: Waiter, table for two, any seats available please?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 大廳得返一張搭檯，介唔介意？
dialogue.jyutping: daai6 teng1 dak1 faan1 jat1 zoeng1 daap3 toi2, gaai3 m4 gaai3 ji3?
dialogue.translation: Only a shared table left in the main hall, do you mind?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 冇所謂，搭檯都得。請問今日有咩茶？
dialogue.jyutping: mou5 so2 wai5, daap3 toi2 dou1 dak1. cing2 man6 gam1 jat1 jau5 me1 caa4?
dialogue.translation: Doesn't matter, sharing is fine. What teas do you have today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 有普洱、香片、鐵觀音同菊普。
dialogue.jyutping: jau5 pou2 nei2, hoeng1 pin2, tit3 gun1 jam1 tung4 guk1 pou2.
dialogue.translation: We have Pu'er, Jasmine, Tieguanyin, and Chrysanthemum Pu'er.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 要一壺香片，再開兩位茶位，唔該！
dialogue.jyutping: jiu3 jat1 wu4 hoeng1 pin2, zoi3 hoi1 loeng5 wai2 caa4 wai2, m4 goi1!
dialogue.translation: A pot of Jasmine tea, and 2 tea covers please!

title: 搭港鐵與問路 Taking the MTR & Directions
titleEn: Navigating the Hong Kong Subway & Station Exits
description: Ask for platform directions, interchange lines (轉綫), reload Octopus card (八達通增值), and find the right station exit.

keywords.meaning_zh: 八達通 / 智能儲值卡
keywords.example: 唔該幫我張八達通增值一百蚊。
keywords.example_meaning: Please top up 100 dollars on my Octopus card.

keywords.example: 喺金鐘站轉港島綫好方便。
keywords.example_meaning: Transferring to the Island Line at Admiralty is very convenient.

keywords.example: 請問朗豪坊由邊個出口出？
keywords.example_meaning: Which exit should I take for Langham Place?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 唔該請問，去銅鑼灣應該喺邊個月台搭車？
dialogue.jyutping: m4 goi1 cing2 man6, heoi3 tung4 lo4 waan1 jing1 goi1 hai2 bin1 go3 jyut6 toi4 daap3 ce1?
dialogue.translation: Excuse me, which platform should I take to go to Causeway Bay?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 你搭荃灣綫去到金鐘站，行過對面月台轉港島綫就得喇。
dialogue.jyutping: nei5 daap3 cyun4 waan1 sin3 heoi3 dou3 gam1 zung1 zaam6, haang4 gwo3 deoi3 min6 jyut6 toi4 zyun3 gong2 dou2 sin3 zau6 dak1 laa3.
dialogue.translation: Take the Tsuen Wan Line to Admiralty station, then walk to the opposite platform to interchange to the Island Line.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 明白！另外請問八達通客服中心喺邊度？我想增值。
dialogue.jyutping: ming4 baak6! ling6 ngoi6 cing2 man6 baat3 daat6 tung1 haak3 fuk6 zung1 sam1 hai2 bin1 dou6? ngo5 soeng2 zang1 zik6.
dialogue.translation: Understood! Also, where is the Customer Service Centre? I would like to top up my Octopus card.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 直行到閘機旁邊就見到客服中心，或者用自動增值機都得。
dialogue.jyutping: zik6 haang4 dou3 zaap6 gei1 pong4 bin1 zau6 gin3 dou2 haak3 fuk6 zung1 sam1, waak6 ze2 jung6 zi6 dung6 zang1 zik6 gei1 dou1 dak1.
dialogue.translation: Walk straight past the turnstiles to see the service desk, or you can use the automatic top-up machine.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 好清晰，唔該曬你！
dialogue.jyutping: hou2 cing1 sik1, m4 goi1 saai3 nei5!
dialogue.translation: Very clear, thank you so much!

title: 茶飲店叫凍檸茶 / 珍珠奶茶 Ordering Bubble Tea
titleEn: Customizing Sweetness & Ice Levels at Modern HK Drink Shops
description: Customize sweetness (微糖/少甜), ice levels (去冰/少冰), and add toppings like pearls (珍珠) and coconut jelly (椰果).

keywords.example: 我要一杯黑糖珍奶，微糖。
keywords.example_meaning: I want a brown sugar pearl milk tea, quarter sugar.

keywords.example: 天氣凍，杯凍檸茶幫我走冰。
keywords.example_meaning: It's cold today, make my iced lemon tea with no ice.
Add 5 dollars for extra pearls.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 你好！我想叫一杯黑糖珍珠鮮奶，再要一杯港式凍檸茶。
dialogue.jyutping: nei5 hou2! ngo5 soeng2 giu3 jat1 bui1 hak1 tong4 zan1 zyu1 sin1 naai5, zoi3 jiu3 jat1 bui1 gong2 sik1 dung3 ning4 caa4.
dialogue.translation: Hello! I would like a brown sugar pearl fresh milk, and a Hong Kong iced lemon tea.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 好，甜度同冰量想點樣較？
dialogue.jyutping: hou2, tim4 dou6 tung4 bing1 loeng6 soeng2 dim2 joeng2 gaau3?
dialogue.translation: Sure, how would you like the sweetness and ice levels adjusted?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 珍珠鮮奶微糖少冰，凍檸茶半糖去冰，唔該。
dialogue.jyutping: zan1 zyu1 sin1 naai5 mei4 tong4 siu2 bing1, dung3 ning4 caa4 bun3 tong4 heoi3 bing1, m4 goi1.
dialogue.translation: Pearl fresh milk quarter sugar less ice, iced lemon tea half sugar no ice, please.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 冇問題，總共四十八蚊，請問八達通定現金比錢？
dialogue.jyutping: mou5 man6 tai4, zung2 gung6 sei3 sap6 baat3 man1, cing2 man6 baat3 daat6 tung1 ding6 jin6 gam1 bei2 cin2?
dialogue.translation: No problem, total is 48 dollars. Would you like to pay with Octopus or cash?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 嘟八達通，唔該！
dialogue.jyutping: dut1 baat3 daat6 tung1, m4 goi1!
dialogue.translation: Beep Octopus please!

title: 求職面試與職場交流 Job Interview & Workplace Greeting
description: Practice introducing past career experience, greeting hiring managers, discussing deadlines, and Hong Kong business terminology.

keywords.meaning_zh: 跟進 / 跟進項目進度
keywords.example: 呢個項目由我親自跟進。
keywords.example_meaning: I will personally follow up on this project.

keywords.example: 我有五年數碼營銷嘅經驗。
keywords.example_meaning: I have 5 years of digital marketing experience.

keywords.example: 我哋聽朝十點開團隊會議。
keywords.example_meaning: We will hold a team meeting tomorrow morning at 10 o'clock.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 陳先生早晨，請坐。請你先簡單介紹一下你自己嘅工作背景。
dialogue.jyutping: can4 sin1 saang1 zou2 san4, cing2 co5. cing2 nei5 sin1 gaan2 daan1 gaai3 siu6 jat1 haa5 nei5 zi6 gei2 ge3 gung1 zok3 bui3 ging2.
dialogue.translation: Good morning Mr. Chan, please have a seat. Please briefly introduce your professional background.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 面試官早晨，我喺科技行業有三年項目管理經驗，主要負責團隊協作同跟進客務。
dialogue.jyutping: min6 si3 gun1 zou2 san4, ngo5 hai2 fo1 gei6 hong4 jip6 jau5 saam1 nin4 hong6 muk6 gun2 lei5 ging1 jim6, zyu2 jiu3 fu6 zaak3 tyun4 deoi2 hip3 zok3 tung4 gan1 zeon3 haak3 mou6.
dialogue.translation: Good morning, I have 3 years of project management experience in the tech industry, mainly responsible for team collaboration and client follow-ups.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 如果遇到好趕嘅截止日期（Deadline），你平時會點樣處理？
dialogue.jyutping: jyu4 gwo2 jyu6 dou2 hou2 gon2 ge3 kit3 zi2 jat6 kei4 (Deadline), nei5 ping4 si4 wui5 dim2 joeng2 cyu2 lei5?
dialogue.translation: If you encounter a very tight deadline, how do you usually handle it?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 我會先按輕重緩急排好優先次序，主動同團隊開會溝通，確保準時交貨。
dialogue.jyutping: ngo5 wui5 sin1 on3 hing1 zung6 wun6 gap1 paai4 hou2 jau1 sin1 ci3 zeoi6, zyu2 dung6 tung4 tyun4 deoi2 hoi1 wui2 kau1 tung1, kok3 bou2 zeon2 si4 gaau1 fo3.
dialogue.translation: I will prioritize tasks by urgency and importance, proactively meet with the team to communicate, and ensure timely delivery.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 好好，我哋好欣賞你嘅溝通態度！
dialogue.jyutping: hou2 hou2, ngo5 dei6 hou2 jan1 soeng2 nei5 ge3 kau1 tung1 taai3 dou6!
dialogue.translation: Very good, we appreciate your communication attitude!

title: 地產代理租屋睇樓 Renting an Apartment & Flat Viewing
titleEn: Inquiring About Flat Rentals, Utilities & Lease Terms
description: Ask about monthly rent (叫價), usable square feet (實用面積), clubhouse amenities (會所), and lease deposits (按金).

keywords.meaning_zh: 實用面積 / 室內淨面積
keywords.example: 呢間屋實用面積有四百五十呎。
keywords.example_meaning: This flat has a saleable area of 450 square feet.

keywords.example: 租屋通常要交兩個月按金。
keywords.example_meaning: Renting a flat usually requires 2 months deposit.

keywords.meaning_zh: 交通方便 / 出行便捷
keywords.example: 行去地鐵站五分鐘，交通好方便。
keywords.example_meaning: 5 minutes walk to the MTR station, very convenient transport.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 陳小姐你好，我想睇下沙田附近兩房嘅租盤，預算萬四蚊左右。
dialogue.jyutping: can4 siu2 ze2 nei5 hou2, ngo5 soeng2 tai2 haa5 saa1 tin4 fu6 gan6 loeng5 fong4 ge3 zou1 pun4, jyu6 syun3 maan6 sei3 man1 zo2 jau6.
dialogue.translation: Hello Ms. Chan, I would like to look at two-bedroom rentals around Sha Tin, budget around $14,000.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 啱啱好！附近有一個高層筍盤，實用面積四百呎，叫價萬三千五。
dialogue.jyutping: ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2! fu6 gan6 jau5 jat1 go3 gou1 cang4 seon2 pun4, sat6 jung6 min6 zik1 sei3 baak3 cek3, giu3 gaa3 maan6 saam1 cin1 ng5.
dialogue.translation: Just right! There is a high-floor good deal nearby, 400 square feet usable, asking $13,500.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 請問包唔包差餉同管理費？大廈有冇電梯？
dialogue.jyutping: cing2 man6 baau1 m4 baau1 caa1 hoeng3 tung4 gun2 lei5 fai3? daai6 haa6 jau5 mou5 din6 tai1?
dialogue.translation: Does it include government rates and management fees? Does the building have an elevator?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 租金包管理費同差餉，大廈有二十四小時保安同新式電梯，行去地鐵站只要五分鐘。
dialogue.jyutping: zou1 gam1 baau1 gun2 lei5 fai3 tung4 caa1 hoeng3, daai6 haa6 jau5 ji6 sap6 sei3 siu4 si4 bou2 on1 tung4 san1 sik1 din6 tai1, haang4 heoi3 dei6 tit3 zaam6 zi2 jiu3 ng5 fan1 zung1.
dialogue.translation: Rent includes management fee and rates. Building has 24-hr security and modern elevators, only 5 mins walk to the station.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 環境聽落好理想，今日可唔可以約去睇樓？
dialogue.jyutping: waan4 ging2 teng1 lok6 hou2 lei5 soeng2, gam1 jat1 ho2 m4 ho2 ji5 joek3 heoi3 tai2 lau2?
dialogue.translation: Sounds very ideal, can we arrange a viewing today?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 冇問題，我即刻聯絡業主攞鎖匙！
dialogue.jyutping: mou5 man6 tai4, ngo5 zik1 hak1 lyun4 lok3 jip6 zyu2 lo2 so2 si4!
dialogue.translation: No problem, I will contact the landlord right away for keys!

title: 傳統餅店買蛋撻菠蘿油 Hong Kong Traditional Bakery
titleEn: Ordering Fresh Warm Pastries at a Neighborhood Bakery
description: Order fresh-out-of-the-oven pastries, choose egg tart crust styles (酥皮定牛油皮), and buy piping hot pineapple buns with thick butter slab (菠蘿油).

keywords.meaning_zh: 啱啱出爐 / 新鮮剛烘焙出爐
keywords.meaning: Freshly baked / hot out of the oven
keywords.example: 呢盤蛋撻啱啱出爐，熱辣辣。
keywords.example_meaning: This tray of egg tarts is fresh out of the oven, piping hot.

keywords.meaning_zh: 菠蘿油 / 菠蘿包夾厚切牛油
keywords.meaning: Pineapple bun with thick slab of cold butter
keywords.example: 食菠蘿油一定要趁熱食。
keywords.example_meaning: Pineapple bun with butter must be eaten while hot.

keywords.meaning_zh: 酥皮 / 千層酥脆撻皮
keywords.example: 我鍾意食酥皮蛋撻多過牛油皮。
keywords.example_meaning: I prefer flaky crust egg tarts over cookie butter crust.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 老闆，請問蛋撻係咪啱啱出爐？有冇酥皮？
dialogue.jyutping: lou5 baan2, cing2 man6 daan2 taat3 hai6 mai6 ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 lou4? jau5 mou5 sou1 pei4?
dialogue.translation: Boss, are the egg tarts fresh out of the oven? Do you have flaky crust?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 係呀，啱啱出爐熱辣辣！酥皮同牛油皮都有，幾多個？
dialogue.jyutping: hai6 aa3, ngaam1 ngaam1 ceot1 lou4 jit6 laat6 laat6! sou1 pei4 tung4 ngau4 jau4 pei4 dou1 jau5, gei2 do1 go3?
dialogue.translation: Yes, fresh out of the oven piping hot! Both flaky and butter cookie crust available, how many?

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 要半打酥皮蛋撻，再加個菠蘿油夾厚牛油，唔該！
dialogue.jyutping: jiu3 bun3 daa2 sou1 pei4 daan2 taat3, zoi3 gaa1 go3 bo1 lo4 jau4 gaap3 hau5 ngau4 jau4, m4 goi1!
dialogue.translation: Half a dozen flaky crust egg tarts, and a pineapple bun with thick butter, please!

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: 好，幫你裝入紙袋。菠蘿油趁熱食，牛油溶咗最好食！
dialogue.jyutping: hou2, bong1 nei5 zong1 jap6 zi2 doi6. bo1 lo4 jau4 can3 jit6 sik6, ngau4 jau4 jung4 zo2 zeoi3 hou2 sik6!
dialogue.translation: Sure, packed in a paper bag for you. Eat the pineapple bun while hot, tastes best when the butter melts!

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: 多謝老闆，好香呀！
dialogue.jyutping: do1 ze6 lou5 baan2, hou2 hoeng1 aa3!
